rawContent: #MeToo continues to expose the ways in which sexual harassment is baked into so many aspects of life: “He set a horrifying standard of what women who work in the Jewish community were expected to endure.” https://t.co/fe8teedhXW

.@ruthreichl's #MeToo take, from this smart Q&A with @John_Birdsall: "It was transactional, right? You just took it for granted that men were going to come on to you, talk dirty to you. We accepted it, and we should never have, but it was the way of the world."
